name: grill-me-jewel
description: A guided jewelry interview that turns vague ideas into confirmed gpt-image-2 jewelry designs.

interface.shortDescription: 通过结构化访谈明确方向，并用 gpt-image-2 生成珠宝设计图。
interface.longDescription: Grill Me Jewel asks a few focused questions at a time in a compact Apps UI, preserves prior answers, confirms one coherent jewelry brief, and then uses Codex gpt-image-2 to generate the requested independent design images.
defaultPrompt: 我只有一个模糊的珠宝想法，请先用表单梳理，再生成设计图。
进入 Grill Me 珠宝模式，确认 brief 后用 Image-2 出图。
Interview me about a jewelry idea, confirm the brief, then generate the design image.
